e.title: burncost (Python)
e.summary: 费率化损失经验准备 Python 库（PyPI，MIT）：链梯/BF 损失发展+趋势估计+平行四边形 on-leveling
e.body: burncost 是费率化（ratemaking）就绪的损失经验准备 Python 库（PyPI，MIT，beta）：损失发展（链梯、Bornhuetter-Ferguson）、趋势估计、以及平行四边形法（parallelogram method）的保费 on-leveling——设计为下游费率模型的数据准备层。对 RIAA：费率厘定数据准备的实用库（发展→趋势→on-leveling 链条）。与 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[chainladder]]（发展）、[[actudist]]（分布）、[[insurance-trend]]（burning-cost 趋势）互补。关联 [[insurancerating]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。

e.summary_en: Python library for ratemaking-ready loss-experience preparation (PyPI, MIT): chain-ladder/BF loss development + trend estimation + parallelogram-method premium on-leveling
e.summary_hk: 費率化損失經驗準備 Python 庫（PyPI，MIT）：鏈梯/BF 損失發展+趨勢估計+平行四邊形 on-leveling
e.body_en: burncost is a Python library for ratemaking-ready loss-experience preparation (PyPI, MIT, beta): loss development (chain-ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson), trend estimation, and premium on-leveling via the parallelogram method — designed as the data-preparation layer for a downstream rate model. For RIAA: a practical library for ratemaking data preparation (development → trend → on-leveling chain). Complements [[actuarial-pricing]], [[chainladder]] (development), [[actudist]] (distributions) and [[insurance-trend]] (burning-cost trend). Related: [[insurancerating]], [[machine-learning-pricing]].
e.body_hk: burncost 是費率化（ratemaking）就緒的損失經驗準備 Python 庫（PyPI，MIT，beta）：損失發展（鏈梯、Bornhuetter-Ferguson）、趨勢估計、以及平行四邊形法（parallelogram method）的保費 on-leveling——設計為下游費率模型的數據準備層。對 RIAA：費率釐定數據準備的實用庫（發展→趨勢→on-leveling 鏈條）。與 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[chainladder]]（發展）、[[actudist]]（分佈）、[[insurance-trend]]（burning-cost 趨勢）互補。關聯 [[insurancerating]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。
